author: Otis T. Mason (section editor); vocabulary by Dr. John Sibley
heading_as_printed: Dr. Sibley's vocabulary was taken in 1804, when the Caddos were located on Red river, from Alexandria to Natchitoches, and follows the French orthography :
place: Red River, from Alexandria to Natchitoches, Louisiana
collector: Dr. John Sibley, agent for the Caddos
transmission: Received by the journal from Judge J. F. H. Claiborne of Natchez, Miss., who wrote that it was prepared and sent to his uncle, Gov. Claiborne of Louisiana, by Dr. Sibley; printed from that manuscript copy.
about: A Caddo vocabulary taken in 1804 by Dr. Sibley, agent for the Caddos on the Red River, and sent to Governor Claiborne of Louisiana, whose nephew J. F. H. Claiborne passed it to the American Naturalist.
